view.title: P1 — The spine in one picture (weeks 0–3)
view.caption: What are we building in weeks 0–3? One Spring Boot deployable that turns manual-test exports into IR, captures device UI evidence, and replays committed tests into a classified, pinned, auditable verdict — with no LLM call anywhere. Drill down: P2 (module map), P3 (replay flow); engineer-grade detail in docs/mobile-test-automation-diagrams/.

omitted.label: Screening library
omitted.note: invoked at all three spine call sites — ingestion egress, hierarchy capture, artifact landing (ADR 0009 as amended, M35); shown in P2 (not shown here for brevity)

omitted.label: CI pipeline
omitted.note: fitness functions F1–F4 run CI-blocking from task zero (M18); the static gate is shown in P3 (not shown here for brevity)

nodes.label: QA engineer
detail: Runs the ingestion CLI and the hierarchy-tool CLI. In the spine the system receives only committed artifacts — the Copilot-assisted conversion arrives in weeks 3–8

nodes.label: Mobile Test Automation Spine
detail: One Spring Boot deployable, modular monolith, three cluster modules (ADR 0005) — the weeks 0–3 subset of the Mobile Test Automation LLM Pipeline; lands in a separate new repository (S2)
The spine contains no LLM call anywhere; the week-3 gate exercises a hand-written test precisely so the pipeline is proven before any generated code reaches it
Week-3 gate: (a) one hand-written Appium test flows end to end and yields a valid ReplayReport; (b) real source material ingested and recorded REAL_INGESTED in lineage (M19)

nodes.label: Excel workbooks
detail: "The least deterministic input" — the M16 week-0 corpus request (10–20 representative real workbooks) defines the adapter's effective contract; raw workbooks never enter Git (M35). ALM/QC stays additive later (C1)

nodes.label: ALM Octane
detail: Ingest source in the spine (REST, API-key auth — C1); certified-asset publish is weeks 3–8 (CF3). SLA: UNKNOWN (pending)

nodes.label: Perfecto device lab
detail: Pinned device pools; artifacts produced off-prem, hashed at pull (M9) and screened at landing (M35). INCUMBENT vendor — SLA: UNKNOWN (pending — M1 probe)

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
detail: WORKING ASSUMPTION (C3) — conversion state, append-only lineage (hash-chained, ADR 0012), DB-backed queue/outbox (ADR 0007); swappable if the bank's catalog dictates

nodes.label: object storage
detail: Evidence artifacts behind an S3-compatible port (ADR 0011, BINDING PROBE-PENDING; default = self-operated MinIO). Spine retention deliberately short: 30 days, class SPINE_POC (M39)

edges.label: reads workbooks from
edges.detail: Excel adapter (Apache POI) behind the shared source-adapter contract (C1)

edges.label: ingests manual tests from
edges.detail: Octane REST adapter (API-key auth) behind the same source-adapter contract (C1)

edges.label: captures evidence + replays tests on
edges.detail: Hierarchy-tool capture (getPageSource, Object Spy, pruned tree) + device-gate replay on pinned pools; single-run session tokens (ADR 0013)

edges.label: writes state + lineage in one transaction to
edges.detail: Every pipeline action writes its lineage row in the same local transaction as its state change (ADR 0007)

edges.label: lands hashed, screened evidence in
edges.detail: Per-artifact SHA-256 at landing (M9); data classification + retention date + retention class on every artifact (M39)
